members.name: Md Mahamudul Hasan
members.tagline: Building the system behind the idea.
members.about: Responsible for the technical direction of the FYDP, including system architecture design, frontend & backend implementation, database modeling, and deployment pipelines.

Frontend & backend development with Next.js & React
Database integration, API modeling and state management
Production deployment and performance optimization

members.name: Md Sabbir Hossen
members.tagline: Bridging team progress with supervisor consultations and presentation delivery.
members.about: Serves as the primary point of contact for supervisor and faculty consultations, coordinating milestone reviews, feedback implementation, and leading project defense presentations.
responsibilities: Faculty and supervisor communications, meeting scheduling, and agenda alignment
Milestone review documentation and supervisor feedback tracking
English presentation delivery, viva defense preparation, and team rehearsals
Demo storytelling, slide design, and defense Q&A coordination

members.name: Tania Islam
members.tagline: Turning existing research into project direction.

responsibilities: Academic literature review and paper benchmarking
Research gap formulation and hypothesis definition
Methodology exploration and comparative analysis
Reference management and thesis documentation guidance

Citation structuring and research paper synthesis
Weekly progress documentation and meeting notes
Assistance with comparative tests and data tables

members.name: Rehnuma Khan
members.tagline: Turning project research & system demos into clear presentations.

Live demo walkthroughs and project storytelling
Viva defense Q&A preparation and mock rehearsals
Presentation slide design and visual storytelling

logs.title: FYDP Topic Proposal Formulation & Feasibility Study
logs.author: Md Mahamudul Hasan
highlights: Drafting formal FYDP project proposal and scoping core software system architecture.
Evaluating candidate problem statements against UIU CSE technical guidelines.
Establishing team development workflow, continuous deployment, and repository governance.

logs.title: Initial Faculty Consultation & Domain Ideation
logs.author: Md Sabbir Hossen
highlights: Conducted preliminary consultation session with prospective faculty supervisor.
Discussed research methodologies, project feasibility, and timeline milestones.
Gathered faculty feedback to refine prospective problem statements and scope boundaries.

logs.title: Background Literature Survey & Gap Analysis
logs.author: Tania Islam
highlights: Surveyed 15+ recent IEEE, ACM, and Springer publications (2022–2026).
Constructed taxonomy comparison matrix identifying critical domain challenges.
Structured literature synthesis notes for the initial proposal documentation.

logs.title: FYDP Team Inception, Role Mapping & Portal Setup
logs.author: Maria Tasnim
highlights: Formed Team Random and mapped specialized technical and research responsibilities.
Deployed centralized collaborative workspace and task directives board.
Initiated Phase 1 milestone tracking under UIU CSE FYDP framework.
